notes: Shallow stratum: the faulty line is 15 lines below the splitByWholeSeparatorWorker signature (14 before the shared comment line). The gold key StringUtils::splitByWholeSeparatorWorker is unique (no overloads) and has four production callers (the splitByWholeSeparator and splitByWholeSeparatorPreserveAllTokens facades). Its own code owns the empty-separator case (`separator == null || EMPTY.equals(separator)` followed by '// Split on whitespace.'). The fault forwards the caller's separator, so for an empty separator splitWorker receives "" and returns the input unsplit. Owner invariance: with the fault, splitByWholeSeparator(input, "") and split(input, "") make the identical call splitWorker(input, "", -1, false), and the trigger requires the first to split on whitespace and the second to keep the string whole, so no edit confined to splitWorker can satisfy both; the two facade assertions also block any single-facade fix. CG cues are comment-only false local facts (refuted by the condition two lines above). CD cues rename splitWorker's parameter separatorChars to a whole-separator name, inviting a comparison with the worker's null-or-empty check; the truth stays visible in the split/splitPreserveAllTokens javadocs ('A null separatorChars splits on whitespace'), splitWorker's own comment ('Null separator means use whitespace') and the trigger's split(input, "") assertion.
